title: Window-loop transition machines
statement: Given a one-tape test machine $R_t$ and a $(K+1)$-tape step machine $R_s$, define a machine for each window-loop phase, all using $K+1$ work tapes and the record-symbol alphabet. At the anchor phase it remains in its unique state without moving or writing; at the test phase it runs $R_t$ embedded on tape zero; at the step phase it is $R_s$; and at the stop phase each window-exit state remains fixed without moving or writing.
hypotheses_covered: A one-work-tape machine $R_t$ over record symbols for $Q,T$, with state type $P_t$
A $(K+1)$-work-tape machine $R_s$ over record symbols for $Q,T$, with state type $P_s$
